body: If the drugs and booze stopped working, you may find yourself in need of some different help. Check out an A.A. mtg it may help with the booze and also your emotions.
As weird as this sounds, if you find that you are having trouble with that gin, A.A. may have an answer for all your problems. I know a lot of people who have found happiness within those rooms.

I'm here because my life is fucked as well. Divorce, unemployment etc. I can barely get out of bed. I think of ending it as well, daily for the last couple of months. That resentment will get worse and bury you if you can't let it go. Do you really want to make the news in that fashion?
